purpose: Frozen pre-registered target denominator for claim-rate aggregation. Rates are ALWAYS k/85. A target absent from a campaign or dropped in admission counts as a FAILURE, never removed from the denominator.
why_v2: v1 declared sources_cross_verified = [python/flexaidds/dataset_runner/datasets/astex_diverse.yaml, strict_pair_targets_20260712.csv (Codex audit)]. Both are descendants of the roster being verified, so v1 cross-checked a file against its own copies. That is replication, not verification, and it is why a 13-of-85 substitution survived four in-repo copies of the list. v2 cross-references only sources OUTSIDE the repository: the primary paper's own table, and RCSB.

cross_references.citation: Hartshorn et al. (2007) J. Med. Chem. 50(4):726-741
cross_references.extraction_method: PDF text layer parsed by character position: baseline clustering into lines, x-coordinate binning into the table's six columns; line-anchored code pattern ^[0-9][a-z][a-z0-9]{2}; count asserted against the caption's own stated N. Glyph decoding (beta, alpha vs Latin R) confirmed against 200-dpi page renders.

cross_references.endpoint: https://data.rcsb.org (REST core/entry, holdings, and GraphQL entries/chem_comps)

cross_references.why_not_circular: its ligand_title column is derived from the cached ligand SDFs, not from the roster's ligand_id column, so it is independent OF THE COLUMN BEING CHECKED. It is recorded as corroboration only and is not load-bearing: the primary and RCSB references above are.
cross_references.disagreement: 1HQ2: cached ligand APC (ATP analogue/cofactor) vs Table 2 compound HP = CCD PH2

sha256_of_sorted_codes_input: lowercase codes, sorted ascending, newline-joined, trailing newline

supersedes.its_undeclared_input_convention: reproduced only after testing 10 conventions: UPPERCASE codes, sorted, COMMA-joined, no trailing newline. v1 does not state its convention, so its hash cannot be re-verified without guessing. v2 states the convention in sha256_of_sorted_codes_input. The hash was never the defect -- it faithfully hashes the wrong list.
supersedes.status: NOT deleted and NOT edited: a docking lane is reading the live definition tree.
